2) Does Redwood support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for the pilot environment? Our security team prefers CMEK where feasible.

3) For the DPA: procurement needs either a signed PDF or an active DocuSign envelope. Can you send a DocuSign link addressed to procurement@cloudforge.com?

If you can answer these and either send the DocuSign link or indicate you accept the attached PDF for their intake, we can get the PO generated today.

Hi Maria / Alex — looping in Ben and Marissa for billing/PO-side confirmation and answering the technical questions below. Quick responses: 

1) Replication & logging: the logging/metrics vendor is configured with pseudonymized event IDs only for analytics; we do not replicate customer-identifiable payloads to eu-west-1 for the pilot. We will provide an exportable schema and evidence log if Risk needs it.

2) CMEK: for hosted pilots we do not yet offer customer-managed keys by default, but we support a Bring-Your-Own-Key flow on Dedicated or Private deployments. For this pilot (hosted), we can add IP-based isolation and strict KMS scoping and provide a control note; if CloudForge requires CMEK, we can scope that as a professional services item.

3) Docusign: Rohan, I can generate and send a DocuSign envelope today addressed to procurement@cloudforge.com and abennett@cloudforge.com. Once signed, procurement can attach the signed PDF to the PO.

Ben / Marissa — can you confirm Net 30 acceptance and whether accounts payable needs any vendor setup ID before the PO is issued?

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Compliance | Redwood Inference
